## Final review

# Narrative Final Review

Check scene or argument movement, paragraph development, concrete detail, causal continuity, earned interpretation, sparse visible scaffolding, and resistance to generic moral summaries.

Reject list-shaped prose: successive short standalone paragraphs that merely enumerate points. Develop and connect them as continuous prose, or, when list structure is explicitly permitted, use real bullets or numbering.
